note: Scoped accepted pause/recipient-skip metadata, including optional frequency-cap sequence and follow-up fields. Original pause producer is API326. Full baseline snapshots/API version remain unchanged; source acceptance is not environment availability or publication.

pausedAt.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the campaign paused

reason.description: Why Polymorfa paused the campaign. Present only on an automatic pause.
reason.example: WhatsApp lowered the messaging limit of a number this campaign sends from.

code.description: Stable code for an automatic pause: campaigns_not_entitled, bansafe_org_suspended, bansafe_suspended, campaign_throughput_capped, invalid_parameter, hybrid_campaign_unsupported, blocked_by_safety, number_quality_dropped, or messaging_limit_dropped. Present only on an automatic pause.

reason.description: Stable skip reason: optout, frequency_cap_exceeded for a campaign contact cap, or whatsapp_marketing_limit when WhatsApp withheld a marketing message because the person reached their per-user marketing message limit

messageIndex.description: Position from 0 of a capped sequence message. Above 0, the initial send status is preserved and remaining sequence messages stop.

followUpId.description: Receipt-timed follow-up cancelled by the contact frequency cap; the initial send status is preserved.

skippedAt.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the recipient was skipped
